channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay South Block 18A (UCSF planned)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 18A (UCSF planned) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 18A (UCSF planned): Block 18A's 'planned' status now says what it rests on: UCSF's land-use designation of the block as Research, not an approved or scheduled project. UCSF's June 2025 presentation lists it among 'Undeveloped parcels remaining' and says 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'.
item.description: Block 18A's 'planned' status now says what it rests on: UCSF's land-use designation of the block as Research, not an approved or scheduled project. UCSF's June 2025 presentation lists it among 'Undeveloped parcels remaining' and says 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'. Source: UCSF Mission Bay Planned Development, CAC presentation, June 12, 2025 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 18A (UCSF planned): Block 18A's notes placed it west of the Owens St curve, north of Nelson Rising Lane, and back-to-back with the existing childcare building 18C. UCSF's map and our own map shape put it south of Nelson Rising Lane and east of the curve, with 18B between it and 18C. The parking-lot statement is now labelled an imagery observation, the equal-area split is described as our approximation, and the 2019 milestone now cites the December 2015 property management plan map.
item.description: Block 18A's notes placed it west of the Owens St curve, north of Nelson Rising Lane, and back-to-back with the existing childcare building 18C. UCSF's map and our own map shape put it south of Nelson Rising Lane and east of the curve, with 18B between it and 18C. The parking-lot statement is now labelled an imagery observation, the equal-area split is described as our approximation, and the 2019 milestone now cites the December 2015 property management plan map.
